sentences.text: 2. During the pendency of the petition both petitioner and respondent No.2 filed joint compromise application under Section 320 read with Section 420 of Cr.P.C to compound the offence.
Divorce is granted by the family court.
The respondent No.2 submits in the M.C matter entire alimony is received by way of settlement.

3. In view of the submission made by both the counsels, as per the judgment of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Gian Singh vs State of Punjab and another (2012) 10 SCC 303, where the parties are permitted to compound the offences.
C/W CRL.P NO.3272 of 2023 Consequently, both the petitions are allowed.
